data.body: 549b change 2552 patchset 2: LLM-Review-1 with 1 blocking (vintage gate git-logs INSTALLED catalog path — outside repo_root in a wheel install — so every packaged-rubric criterion silently collapses to no-committed-prompt-history) + 3 advisories. Fixed blocking RED-first: rubric_path now resolves the canonical in-repo source path <repo_root>/src/rebar/llm/reviewers/<fallback_file> (falls back to installed only when absent). New held-out RED test test_vintage_git_logs_in_repo_rubric_not_installed_catalog (killed by mutation). Advisory #3 (one criterion both fire+no_fire) covered with new test (killed by concat-swap mutation). Advisory #1 (env-mutation reader) ACCEPTED: single-threaded batch tool, mirrors labels.py sanctioned pattern, injection seam available. Advisory #2 (default-criteria branch) DEFERRED: thin wrapper over independently-tested effective_routing+_has_eval_spec. 27 passed, lint+typecheck green. Amended, pushed patchset 3.
